SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM
(
    SELECT CRDACCT_NBR FROM busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 GROUP BY CRDACCT_NBR
    UNION
    SELECT CRDACCT_NBR FROM busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 GROUP BY CRDACCT_NBR
) A

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) CNT FROM BUSC.TRY_LegalEntity WHERE STATUS != 'Disabled'
AND (ROLES LIKE '%Client%' OR ROLES LIKE '%CounterParty%')
AND (FULL_NAME NOT LIKE 'GROUP-%' OR FULL_NAME NOT LIKE 'SETTLE_BANK%')
AND isActive= 1 AND isLatest = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM busc.TRU_PORTFOLIO WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_NO


SELECT COUNT(*) CNT
    FROM (
        SELECT A.ACID, A.CUST_ID, A.BANK_ID
        FROM 
            (SELECT * FROM busc.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP WHERE isActive = 1 AND CONVERT(INT,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) <= 20240122 AND DEL_FLG = 'N') A
        INNER JOIN 
            (SELECT * FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 AND ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y') B
            ON A.ACID = B.ACID AND A.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
        GROUP BY A.ACID, A.CUST_ID, A.BANK_ID
        ) A



SELECT COUNT(*) CNT
    FROM (
        SELECT A.ACID, A.CUST_ID, A.BANK_ID
        FROM 
            (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN WHERE isActive = 1 AND CONVERT(INT,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) <= 20240122 AND DEL_FLG = 'N') A
        INNER JOIN 
            (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 AND ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y') B
            ON A.ACID = B.ACID AND A.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
        GROUP BY A.ACID, A.CUST_ID, A.BANK_ID
        ) A


SELECT TOP 10 * FROM busc.TRU_CUST
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM busc.TRU_BASELINK

SELECT COUNT(*) CNT 
    FROM (
        SELECT A.PORTFOLIO_NO, C.UNIQUE_ID
        FROM (SELECT BASE_NO, PORTFOLIO_NO FROM busc.TRU_PORTFOLIO WHERE isActive = 1 AND CONVERT(INT,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) <= 20240122 
                GROUP BY BASE_NO, PORTFOLIO_NO) A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.TRU_BASELINK WHERE isActive = 1 AND CONVERT(INT,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) <= 20240122) B
            ON A.BASE_NO = B.CUST_NO
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.TRU_CUST WHERE isActive = 1 AND CONVERT(INT,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) <= 20240122) C
            ON B.CUST_NO = C.CUST_NO
        ) A


SELECT TOP 10 ID, EXTERNAL_REF FROM busc.TRY_LEGALENTITY WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM
    (SELECT CustomerAccountId, CustomerId FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, CustomerId) A



SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM (
        SELECT FORACID, SCHM_CODE FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 AND ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID, SCHM_CODE) A

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FORACID) FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1
SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM (
        SELECT FORACID, SCHM_CODE FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 AND ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID, SCHM_CODE) A


SELECT TOP 10 * FROM busc.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK
SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM 
(
    SELECT ACCTKEY, CLTCODE FROM busc.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 GROUP BY ACCTKEY, CLTCODE
) A

(
    SELECT CRDACCT_NBR, CRDACCT_PDT_NBR FROM busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 GROUP BY CRDACCT_NBR, CRDACCT_PDT_NBR
    UNION
    SELECT CRDACCT_NBR, CRDACCT_PDT_NBR FROM busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 GROUP BY CRDACCT_NBR, CRDACCT_PDT_NBR
) A

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PORTFOLIO_NO) FROM busc.TRU_PORTFOLIO WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM
    (SELECT PORTFOLIO_NO, PROD_CODE FROM busc.TRU_PORTFOLIO WHERE isActive = 1 AND CONVERT(INT,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) <= 20240122 GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_NO, PROD_CODE) A

SELECT CounterParty_ID, Tag, COUNT(*) 
    FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN Product_Type = 'StructuredFlows' AND TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TradeType = 'DSA' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type = 'StructuredFlows' AND TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TradeType = 'TCD' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type = 'StructuredFlows' AND TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TradeType = 'Res-TCD' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type = 'StructuredFlows' AND TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TradeType = 'PN' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type = 'BondMMDiscount' AND Name like 'BSP Bill%' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type = 'BondMMDiscount' AND PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN like 'PIBL%' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type like 'Bond%' AND BTT.Name like 'RTB%' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type like 'Bond%' AND PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN like 'PIBD%' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type like 'Bond%' AND Name like 'RDB%' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type like 'Bond%' AND Name like 'ROP%' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type like 'Bond%' AND Name like 'ODB%' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type like 'Bond%' AND Trade_Currency NOT LIKE 'PHP' AND PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BondType = 'N_RESI_GOVT' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type like 'Bond%' AND Trade_Currency = 'PHP' AND PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BondType NOT LIKE 'NG' AND PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BondType NOT LIKE 'RESI_GOVT' AND PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BondType NOT LIKE 'N_RESI_GOVT' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type like 'Bond%' AND Trade_Currency = 'USD' AND PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BondType NOT LIKE 'NG' AND PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BondType NOT LIKE 'RESI_GOVT' AND PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BondType NOT LIKE 'N_RESI_GOVT' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type = 'FX' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type = 'FXForward' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type = 'FXNDF' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type = 'FXSwap' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type = 'Swap' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Product_Type = 'SwapCrossCurrency' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN External_Reference LIKE 'PYA%' AND Product_Type = 'Structured Flows' AND (Bundle_Type IS NULL OR  Bundle_Type ='PYA') THEN 'Y'
        WHEN Bundle_Type = 'ASSET SWAP' THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N' END AS Tag
        , *
        FROM busc.TRY_TRADES
        WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1
    )
    WHERE Tag = 'Y'
    GROUP BY CounterParty_ID, Tag
